analyst.summary: BSE Ltd delivered its best-ever year in FY26 (revenue +59% to Rs.5,148 Cr, PAT +88% to Rs.2,487 Cr) on a structural expiry-day win that gave its Sensex/Bankex derivatives the high-liquidity Thursday slot vacated by NSE, with no one-off items inflating the print. But the stock's ~59-60x trailing P/E, the ~85% concentration of revenue in transaction charges tied to a single regulator-controlled expiry slot, and SEBI's active history of both reallocating expiry days and curbing F&O speculation make the current multiple look ahead of durable, repeatable growth. Recommendation is Hold, with an escalation flag for the quant desk given no score exists yet for this name.
